causal_findings: J8 was not a localization failure: trigger tracing isolated LocaleUtils.java as the only production source loaded by the failing test.
The frozen test-guided switch-completion mechanism generated candidates only in StringEscapeUtils.java and was correctly inapplicable.

The human repair adds a guard for a delimiter occupying the first character of the otherwise-required middle segment, then returns a three-component value with an empty middle component and suffix substring.

The existing parser already exposes all structural ingredients needed to infer the repair: delimiter position, charAt index, prefix substring, middle substring, suffix substring and three-argument constructor.
The inherited repair language lacks a generic empty-middle-segment branch synthesis operation for fixed-layout delimited parsers.
claim_boundary: J8 remains a valid negative. Human-fix and test evidence are used only after the frozen result to diagnose and build successor machinery.
next_development_change: Add a generic Java delimited-parser empty-segment completion operator. It should mine delimiter checks, charAt positions, sibling substring-based constructor returns and adjacent-delimiter structure from source, synthesize an early-return branch with an empty middle component, and encode no Locale, LocaleUtils, language tag, underscore, Lang-54, test, issue, commit or line identity. Validate on synthetic parser fixtures and the consumed J8 replay, then freeze before fresh J9 selection.
